helpCenter.heroDescription: Search for answers or browse categories below
helpCenter.reportDescription: Found a problem? Report to us immediately. All orders are guaranteed.
helpCenter.noResultsDescription: Try searching with different terms or contact us directly
helpCenter.answer1: It's easy, just 3 steps: 1. Choose your preferred laundry shop in the app 2. Select the wash size and services you need 3. Wait for a rider to pick up your clothes at your door. Our team will handle the wash, dry, and fold, then deliver them back to you.
helpCenter.answer2: Currently, SENd covers Mueang District, Sisaket Province and is expanding to Ubon Ratchathani, Maha Sarakham, Roi Et, Khon Kaen, and Kalasin soon.
helpCenter.question3: How long does the laundry take?
helpCenter.answer3: Typically, the turnaround time is 1-3 hours depending on each shop's queue. You can check the estimated time before confirming your order.
helpCenter.question4: What items do you accept for washing?
helpCenter.answer4: We accept regular clothes, bedding, comforters, towels, and small curtains. *We do not accept carpets, shoes, luxury brand items requiring special care, or pet-related fabrics.*
helpCenter.question5: Do you separate whites and colors?
helpCenter.answer5: Absolutely! Our partner shop standards ensure whites and colors are separated to prevent color bleeding, using appropriate water temperatures for each fabric type.
helpCenter.answer6: Our partner shops use hotel-grade industrial detergent and fabric softener. You can also choose a 'Hypoallergenic' formula for sensitive skin (at participating shops).
helpCenter.question7: How is the service fee calculated?
helpCenter.answer7: The fee is based on the wash drum size (kilograms) depending on your chosen shop. Starting price is 49 THB within 4 kilometers, plus 10 THB per additional kilometer.
helpCenter.answer8: We support QR Code scanning (PromptPay), Mobile Banking from all banks, and credit/debit cards (Visa/Mastercard) securely through the app.
helpCenter.question9: Can I get a tax invoice?
helpCenter.answer9: Yes! You can provide your information for an E-Tax Invoice during checkout. The document will be sent to your email within 24 hours.
helpCenter.question10: I can't log in, what should I do?
helpCenter.answer10: Try checking if your registered phone number is correct. If you forgot your password, tap 'Forgot Password' on the Login page to reset via SMS OTP.
helpCenter.question11: Map pin not working / pin is inaccurate
helpCenter.answer11: We recommend enabling GPS (Location Service) before using the app. If the pin is still inaccurate, you can manually drag the map to pin the correct location, or add 'Landmarks' for the rider's reference.
helpCenter.answer12: Please check your account balance or card limit. If it still fails, try switching to QR PromptPay payment or contact your card-issuing bank.
helpCenter.question13: Rider didn't pick up as scheduled
helpCenter.answer13: If the scheduled time has passed by more than 15 minutes, the system will notify our team immediately. You can also tap 'Track Order' on the Order Detail page or message us on LINE.
helpCenter.question14: Are you responsible for lost or damaged clothes?
helpCenter.answer14: We offer damage insurance up to 2,000 THB per order. If clothes are lost or damaged during washing (subject to terms), you can file a claim immediately.
helpCenter.question15: How safe is my personal data?
helpCenter.answer15: SENd places the highest priority on personal data protection (PDPA). Your address and phone number are only shared with the assigned rider and are blocked when the order is completed.
helpCenter.contactDescription: Our team is ready to help you anytime. Contact us now.

blog.title: Laundry Care Tips
blog.description: A collection of tips and methods for caring for your favorite clothes to keep them clean, fresh, and long-lasting.
blog.post1Title: Beginner's Guide: How to Sort Laundry to Prevent Color Bleeding & Damage
blog.post1Excerpt: The first step to proper laundry is 'sorting.' Let's see how to sort clothes to extend the life of your favorites.
blog.post1Content:
Why Sort Your Laundry?

Throwing all your clothes into the washing machine at once may seem convenient, but it can turn your white shirt pink or stretch your wool sweater out of shape. Sorting is the most important step in doing laundry.

1. Sort by Color

  • Whites: School uniforms, white dress shirts, and white socks should always be washed separately, as they easily absorb other colors.
  • Light colors: Pastels, light blue, light pink can be washed together.
  • Dark colors: Navy, black, brown, bright red — these often bleed during the first few washes.

2. Sort by Fabric Weight

Don't wash jeans with thin t-shirts. Zippers and buttons on jeans can snag and tear delicate fabrics, and the weight of wet jeans can distort lighter clothes.

3. Sort by Dirtiness

Office clothes with minimal sweat shouldn't be washed with heavily sweaty gym clothes or rags, as bacteria and odors will transfer to the cleaner clothes.

Pro Tip: Always turn clothes inside out before washing. This helps preserve screen prints and reduces surface friction.
blog.post2Title: Secret Codes on Your Clothes: How to Read Care Label Symbols
blog.post2Excerpt: Stop guessing what those triangles and circles on clothing labels mean. Understand the true meaning behind care symbols for proper garment care.
blog.post2Content:
Have you ever noticed the small label inside your clothes? That's actually the user manual for that garment! Today SENd will help you decode it.

1. Wash Tub (Washing)Shows washing method. A hand dipping in water means "hand wash only." Numbers 30, 40 indicate the maximum water temperature.
2. Triangle (Bleaching)Related to bleach. Empty triangle = safe to bleach. Triangle with X = never bleach.
3. Square (Drying)Tumble dry. Circle inside square = can tumble dry. Dots indicate heat level (one dot = low, two dots = medium).
4. Iron (Ironing)Indicates heat level. More dots = higher heat. X mark means do not iron (common with synthetic fabrics).

Following care labels will help your clothes last longer and give you the best value for money.
blog.post3Title: Musty Clothes? Tips to Eliminate Odors During Rainy Season or Indoor Drying
blog.post3Excerpt: A common problem for dorm and condo residents — laundry that doesn't smell fresh and has a sour odor. Here's how to fix it easily.
blog.post3Content:
What Causes Musty Smell?

Musty odors are caused by bacteria and mold that thrive in moisture. The slower clothes dry, the more bacteria love it.

Basic Solutions

  1. Don't soak clothes overnight: Leaving clothes soaking too long causes the water to become stagnant, breeding bacteria.
  2. Use concentrated fabric softener: Or formulas specifically designed for indoor drying.
  3. Space out hanging clothes: Don't hang clothes too close together. Air needs to circulate freely.
  4. Vinegar helps: Pour 1 cup of white vinegar into the fabric softener compartment for the final rinse. It kills mold and eliminates odors effectively (the vinegar smell disappears once clothes dry).

If none of these work, we recommend using a high-temperature dryer. Heat at 60-70°C will kill all germs and leave your clothes fluffy and fresh guaranteed.
blog.post4Title: Revive Dingy Whites: Kitchen Ingredients to Make White Clothes Bright Again
blog.post4Excerpt: White clothes turning yellow around the collar or looking grayish? Don't throw them away yet! We have secret formulas to revive white fabrics.
blog.post4Content:
School uniforms or work shirts tend to get dingy over time from dust and sweat stains. Try these formulas:

Formula 1: Baking Soda + Lemon

Mix 1 cup of baking soda with lemon juice. Soak clothes for 1 hour before washing as normal. The natural acid helps break down yellow stains.

Formula 2: Rice Water

A traditional Thai method. Soak white clothes in rice rinse water (2nd or 3rd rinse) for 1-2 hours before washing. The vitamins in rice help coat the fibers, making them look whiter.

Warning! Do not use bleach (Chlorine/Clorox) on fabrics containing spandex or elastic material, as it will degrade the elastic and permanently turn it yellow.
blog.post5Title: How to Properly Wash a King-Size Duvet Until It's Clean Inside Out
blog.post5Excerpt: The ultimate laundry challenge: 'duvets.' If your machine isn't big enough, it won't clean properly. And if it doesn't dry, it'll smell musty.
blog.post5Content:
Duvets are prime spots for dust mites. They should be washed at least twice a month, but home washing machines are often too small.

Duvet Washing Techniques

  • Roll before loading: Don't just stuff it in. Roll it into a round shape so the drum weight distributes evenly.
  • Use tennis balls: Put 2-3 clean tennis balls in the dryer. They'll fluff the duvet to prevent clumping.
  • Sun dry for 2 days: Without a dryer, hang in strong sunlight for at least 2 full days, flipping every 4 hours.

Tired of doing it yourself?

A typical 8-10 kg home washing machine isn't suitable for thick duvets.

We recommend using SENd Laundry Service. We have industrial machines 20kg+ that clean duvets deep into the fibers, with gas dryers that kill 100% of dust mites.
